postal_system.scope: Tajik Post locality assignments and postal-office addresses plus UPU format documentation; no areal geometry or current national-completeness claim.

stages.definition: Reviewed assignment, office, rights, quality and UI authority contract with exact reference hashes.

A current complete-for-declared-coverage, rights-cleared Tajik six-digit postcode assignment and exact Polygon/MultiPolygon release preserves shared-code and locality exceptions using explicit permitted relations. Exact retrieval time, edition, validity, CRS, schema, topology, feature identity and SHA-256 reproducibly produce approved immutable artifacts. The real TJ loader and API normalize six-digit input and return valid area geometry. The application searches country plus postcode, distinguishes loading/not-found/multiple/API-failure/invalid/non-area states, fits the map, renders a translucent fill and clear boundary, permits clear and repeat search, and displays normalized postcode, geometry type, official/derived/virtual authority, source, basis date and confidence. Points, postal offices, routes, P.O. boxes, organizations, learned cells and administrative boundaries are never promoted to postal polygons; house numbers and buildings require separate explicit address relations. Synthetic fixtures or shared UI code alone never establish M2.

agid_integration.current_scope: TJ address-format metadata only; no real Postal Context pack, runtime or searchable map area.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Rights-cleared shared-code-aware area artifact plus real loader/API/app verification is required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Only source-qualified Polygon/MultiPolygon postal features can drive the translucent search overlay; all other geometry stays typed and cannot be promoted.
